slides.title: Introduction to Admin
slides.content:
# Django Admin Panel 🎛️

Django includes a powerful, production-ready admin interface!

## What you'll learn:
- **Registering Models** - Add models to admin
- **Customization** - List display, filters, search
- **Actions** - Bulk operations

## Create Superuser

```bash
python manage.py createsuperuser
# Enter username, email, password
```

## Access Admin

```
http://127.0.0.1:8000/admin/
```

> 💡 **The admin is auto-generated!** Just register your models and Django creates CRUD interfaces.

slides.title: Registering Models
slides.content:
# Register Models 📝

## Basic Registration

```python
# admin.py
from django.contrib import admin
from .models import Article, Category

admin.site.register(Article)
admin.site.register(Category)
```

## Customized Registration

```python
@admin.register(Article)
class ArticleAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    list_display = ['title', 'author', 'published', 'is_active']
    list_filter = ['is_active', 'category', 'published']
    search_fields = ['title', 'content']
    date_hierarchy = 'published'
    ordering = ['-published']
    list_per_page = 20
```

## Key Options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `list_display` | Columns to show |
| `list_filter` | Sidebar filters |
| `search_fields` | Search bar fields |
| `ordering` | Default sort |
| `prepopulated_fields` | Auto-fill (slugs) |

slides.title: Summary
slides.content:
# Great Work! 🎉

You've learned Django Admin!

## Key Points
- ✅ Create superuser: `createsuperuser`
- ✅ Register models: `admin.site.register()`
- ✅ Customize with `ModelAdmin`
- ✅ Options: `list_display`, `list_filter`, `search_fields`

> 🚀 **Next Steps:** Learn about Django REST Framework!
